question: Generate 3 hero concepts for the National Day teaser

intro.title: Meet Chloe Tan
intro.text: Creative & Marketing Lead, Mediacorp. National Day eve, 42 assets shipping this weekend, and every tool she owns — Monday, Higgsfield, Adobe — awake in one workspace.

hero.title: The day, pre-briefed
hero.text: Hero film locks at 16:30, the mewatch premiere is fixed at 18:00, and 24 overnight Higgsfield concepts wait for a shortlist. The workspace leads with what matters.

kpis.title: Four numbers, live
kpis.text: Reach 38.6M, up 15%. Velocity 142 assets a week — 4.1x. Cost per asset S$166, down 79%. Engagement 4.8%. Straight from Salesforce and Monday.

chart.title: Output up, cost down
chart.text: Assets shipped versus production cost, month by month. Output 4x since September; cost per asset from S$797 to S$166 once Higgsfield batching went live.

ask.title: Ask for three concepts
ask.text: Chloe types the brief. Higgsfield renders three on-brand hero concepts in 41 seconds — palette, type lockup, 16:9 masters, all against the NDP26 kit.

delegate.title: Delegate the shot-list
delegate.text: One click: assemble the teaser shortlist. It reads the Monday board, batches Higgsfield renders, and hands Farah three picks before the 10:30 review.

autopilot.title: Approvals on autopilot
autopilot.text: Flip the switch. In-policy items like Farah's S$6,800 Adobe Stock top-up clear themselves; the S$126,500 Wunderfolk SOW still waits for Chloe.

mcp.title: Plugged into everything
mcp.text: Under the hood: live connections to Monday, Higgsfield, Adobe, Salesforce and more. Every render and every number traces back to a real system call.

recap.title: Friday, in one click
recap.text: The week recap writes itself — shortlist delivered, 42 assets queued, channel brief drafted for Grace. The wrap-up stops being a Friday-night job.

outro.title: More craft, less chasing
outro.text: Chloe walks into the 16:30 sign-off with everything locked by lunch. That's the point: the copilot batches and chases, she directs.
